profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at Orion 180
profile.summary:
Sr. Software Developer

Full Stack Sr. Software Engineer with over 19 years of experience in software development. Well-versed in all phases of the project lifecycle, with a strong working knowledge of algorithms and data structures. Highly self-motivated and directed with proven analytical and problem-solving abilities. Solutions driven programmer experienced in software development and object-oriented programming.

API Engineering: 
RESTful APIs design and implementation, API integrations, authentication, JSON/XML, API gateways, caching, and performance optimization. 

Microsoft Technology Stack: 
C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, MVC, Entity Framework, LINQ, Visual Studio and Azure. 

Database Engineering: 
SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, query optimization, views, reporting, and multi-database environments. 

Architecture and Quality: 
Microservices, SOLID principles, OOP, middleware architecture, reusable components, API testing, debugging, and documentation. 
DevOps: 
Git and source control, CI/CD pipelines, Cloud fundamentals. 
Front-end Development: JavaScript, Angular, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, vue.js, node.js and others.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with team designing and implementing the API enterprise applications, leveraging JSON, HTTP protocols, and authentication mechanisms to streamline data exchange, troubleshoot integration issues, and improve system interoperability. 
- Developed the main data provider of the company using the following skills: 
API Design and Development, RESTful Web Services, generate and map Request and Response messages and payloads (GET, PUT, POST, DELETE, JSON and XML), API Security and Authentication, API Documentation, API Testing and Debugging, API Performance Optimization, API Gateway Configuration, Microservices Architecture, Dependency Injection and others. 
- Developed backend business logic, transaction processing, and data access layers using C#, .NET 5, and Visual Studio 2022. 
- Optimized SQL database interaction within APIs, resulting in a reduction in query execution time and enhancing overall efficiency. 
- Utilized JSON and XML for data interchange between client and server. 
- Developed and maintained reusable services, middleware, and API components using .NET and C#, following SOLID principles, clean architecture, and industry best practices to deliver reliable, maintainable software solutions. 
- Developed front-end functionalities to ensure consistent and reliable API interfaces 
- Implemented API caching strategies. 
- Enhanced purchasing and checkout workflows using JavaScript and C#. 
- Implemented and maintained CI/CD pipelines to automate application builds, testing, and deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Entity Framework · API Development · jQuery · JSON · SOAP · Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) · JavaScript · Software Infrastructure · Git · Web Services · ASP.NET · HTML · SQL · Bootstrap (Framework) · C# · HTML5 · .NET in Azure · Web Services API · Visual Studio · Angular · XML · Vue.js

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed backend business logic, transaction processing, and data access layers using C#, .NET 5, and Visual Studio 2022. 
- Designed and maintained SQL Server databases, complex T-SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and Entity Framework/LINQ data access layers. 
- Worked with Entity Framework and Link to SQL connected to SQL Server. 
- Maintained complex T-SQL queries, Views and Stored Procedures in multi-database environment. 
- Developed API requests and responses functionalities (using HTTP messaging protocols) 
- Managed application deployments and configuration using Azure DevOps, Git, and automated release pipelines. 
- Maintained Web Application using jQuery, Angular, Bootstrap, html and css 
- Developing solutions according with Third Party companies integrations through APIs. 
- Developed the back end of the application using strong Microsoft stack of technologies including .Net Core 5.0 
- Integrated frontend applications with backend APIs using JavaScript, AngularJS, jQuery, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. 
- Create rich user interfaces and develop back-end transactions/procedures; develop UI, business logic and data access Layer using C# code.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Web API · AngularJS · .NET Framework · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft SQL Server · API Development · jQuery · JavaScript · Web Services · HTML · SQL · Bootstrap (Framework) · C# · HTML5 · .NET in Azure · Web Services API · Visual Studio · Vue.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built REST APIs web services. Developed Web API controllers in C# code for all CRUDs operations with respective routes and Uri’s 
- Developed web services layer using WCF and implemented business logic and use cases 
- Consuming and Developing Windows Communication Foundation services (WCF) 
- Used ADO.NET objects such as Data Adapter, Data Reader, Dataset and Data List for reading/updating records in the database. 
- Developed new modules for the existing Company CRM using .NET Core. 
- Implemented fine tuning of SQL stored procedures and supported performance enhancements 
- Architected and developed REST services Web Api using Entity Framework 
- Legacy application migration. 
- Participated in code reviews, code standards, profiling and testing tasks
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Web Services · HTML · C#

positions.title: Developer Analyst II
positions.description:
- Developed web projects based on MVC4 containing HTML5, AJAX, CSS5, JQuery, javascript, Bootstrap Entity Framework, and AngularJS. 
- Build and developed a cross-platform web applications with Entity Framework, AngularJS and Bootstrap consuming Web services (SOAP) using JSON and XML serialization in VS 2015 with C# language. 
- Responsible for the development of the company in-house CRM system, designing and building all necessary workflows including their main Claim Processing (using C# code, LINQ to SQL, XML and SQL Server) 
- Developed their first enterprise mobile and web application to allow operations to execute real time quotes to potential clients. 
- Responsible for designing, coding, debugging, testing and maintaining modules for all of their existing applications integrated with the team.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · API Development · JavaScript · Web Services · HTML · Bootstrap (Framework) · C# · HTML5 · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and tested user-friendly navigators by utilizing JavaScript, JQuery and C#.NET 
- Created SQL Store Procedures and Views for CRUD operations. 
- Developed, designed and programmed user interface tools using SalesForce (Force.com) 
- Maintained existing logic and applications including the implementation of changes and enhancements to adapt to the requirements of short and long term clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Salesforce.com · JavaScript · HTML · Bootstrap (Framework)

positions.title: Programmer/Developer
positions.description:
- Developer ATIS (Automatic Terminal Information Service) 
- Developed, customized, updated and enhanced software. Managed all phases of application design from coding and prototyping through system testing, integration and deployment. 
- Designed and developed the Automatic Terminal Information System (ATIS) with the purpose of providing communication to the aircraft and improve flights control (using C#, ASP.NET) 
- Assisted with enhancements, updates and code changes to the Air Traffic Control System (ATC) software applications. 
- Troubleshooting issues with software and database, stored procedures, functions and interface 
- Designed and implemented new corporate websites for Flight Plan Systems (FPS).
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · C#
